Nine places to look further, each checked to load before being listed here.

- **Cornell Legal Information Institute (LII): 21 CFR § 606.160** —
  <https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.160>. The full records section this module quotes
  from twice: paragraph (c), the donor-number requirement, and paragraph (e), the per-location and
  cumulative deferred-donor records this module develops in depth for the first time in this
  curriculum. Already used in `reading-a-cfr-citation` and `retention-across-record-types` for its
  other paragraphs — reused here for a third.

- **Cornell Legal Information Institute (LII): 21 CFR § 610.41** —
  <https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/610.41>. This module names 610.41 only, as 606.160(e)
  itself cites it, without quoting its text (not independently saved in `sources/` for this
  curriculum). Use this link if you want to read the actual deferral-and-requalification rule
  606.160(e)'s recordkeeping duty sits on top of.

- **Cornell Legal Information Institute (LII): 21 CFR § 610.40** —
  <https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/610.40>. Same treatment: named only, as the test
  requirement 606.160(e)(2) and (e)(3) cite for the reactive results that trigger a 610.41 deferral.
  Useful background reading on what "tested reactive" actually refers to, not required to complete
  this module.

- **[ISBT 128 and traceability](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=asOWfwczSOY)** (ICCBBA, from oEmbed
  `author_name`) — the video embedded in this lesson. The standards body that manages ISBT 128
  explaining how its identifiers support traceability. General to ISBT 128, not FDA- or
  Lakeshore-specific. Verified embeddable via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[ISBT 128 FAQs](https://www.isbt128.org/faqs)** — ICCBBA's own frequently-asked-questions page.
  Read it for the standards body's plain-language answers on how the identifiers are assigned and
  used, a better source than this lesson for anything specific to ISBT 128. Verified loading via
  `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[ICCBBA home page](https://iccbba.org/)** — the organization behind ISBT 128. Start here for its
  technical documents and implementation guidance on the Donation Identification Number; the lesson
  doesn't reproduce any of that detail. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 630.10, General donor eligibility requirements](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/630.10)**
  — the donor-eligibility rule sitting alongside the deferral recordkeeping this lesson develops.
  Not quoted in this lesson; read it for the eligibility side of the question 606.160(e)'s records
  exist to support. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Review on Master Patient Index (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.05994)** — a paper on the
  master patient index, the healthcare-IT version of the "one person, many records" problem behind
  this lesson's donor-identification question. Not blood-specific; a general-informatics read on
  matching and duplicate records. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[FDA: Blood and Blood Products](https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/blood-blood-products)**
  — FDA's CBER landing page for blood-establishment guidance and regulations, for finding current
  agency material beyond the CFR sections quoted here. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11
  (HTTP 200).
